name: Hanwha Vision CO.,LTD
summary: Hanwha Vision CO.,LTD engages in the production and sale of securities, chip mounters, semiconductor equipment, etc. The company was formerly known as HANWHA INDUSTRIAL SOLUTIONS Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Hanwha Vision CO.,LTD in December 2024. The company was founded in 1952 and is based in Seongnam-si, South Korea. Hanwha Vision CO.,LTD operates as a subsidiary of Hanwha Aerospace Co., Ltd.
